alm_polar_night: Polar Night · the Sun does not rise today
alm_seasons_extreme: seasons are slowly becoming more extreme
alm_dt_tilt_desc: This tilt is why seasons exist. It’s currently {trend}, meaning: {impact}. Cycles between 22.1° and 24.5° over 41,000 years (Milanković cycle). Currently {pct}% through the cycle.
alm_dt_polaris_desc: Earth wobbles like a spinning top. Polaris happens to be near the axis right now, but it’s drifting. Closest alignment ~2100 (0.45°), then it drifts away. In ~{years} years, Vega will be the “North Star.” Full wobble cycle: 25,772 years.
alm_dt_daylen_desc: The Moon’s gravity creates tides that act like brakes on Earth’s spin. Each century, days grow 1.8ms longer. Since the year 2000, days have stretched {ms}ms. Doesn’t sound like much, but 600 million years ago, a day was only 21 hours. The Moon drifts 3.8 cm farther each year, slowly releasing its grip.
alm_dt_orbit_desc: How elliptical Earth’s orbit is (0 = perfect circle, 1 = extremely stretched). Currently near-circular and {trend}. This affects how much solar energy Earth receives over a year. Combined with tilt and precession, these three cycles drive ice ages (Milanković theory).
alm_dt_julian_desc: A continuous count of days since January 1, 4713 BC. Used by astronomers because it never resets, skips, or changes with calendar reforms. Every event in human history has exactly one Julian Date. Immune to leap seconds, timezone changes, and political calendars.
alm_dt_galactic_desc: The Sun orbits the Milky Way’s center every ~225 million years at 828,000 km/h. In {age} billion years, we’ve completed roughly {orbits} orbits. Last time we were here, dinosaurs ruled the Earth.
alm_footer: All calculations are math-driven and work offline forever.

alm_gr_subtitle: 49 images selected by Carl Sagan's team, decoded from analog video signals on a gold-plated phonograph record, now 24+ billion km from Earth.

users_pa_open_desc: Anyone can browse the whole library.
users_pa_limited_desc: Visitors see only the ZIMs you choose.
users_pa_private_desc: Visitors must sign in to see anything.

alm_tm_year_hint: Any year — 0, 10000, or a negative year for BCE

dl_scheduled_tip: Waiting for the nightly download window to open.

backup_library_complete: All backed-up ZIMs are already installed.

backup_missing_unresolved: {n} couldn't be matched in the catalog and must be added manually.
backup_scope_device: This device: your library list, collections, bookmarks, and preferences.
backup_scope_server: Full server (admin): everything above plus user accounts with password hashes, access policy, schedule, and sharing settings — keep this file private.
dl_upload_trickle_hint: Seeding is capped to this rate outside the window.

backup_mydata_intro_account: Your bookmarks, reading history, and preferences. They live in this browser. Save to server keeps a copy in your account on this Zimi server. Other devices signed in to your account can restore them.
backup_server_intro: The whole server: library list, collections, home layout, user accounts (with password hashes), access policy, schedule, sharing, seed intents, hot list, auto-update, event history, and every user's saved data. Keep this file private.
backup_wrong_card_server: That's a full server backup — import it in the Server backup card.
backup_wrong_card_mydata: That's a My data backup — import it in the My data card.

create_mode_folder_desc: HTML, Markdown and PDF files, packaged as they are. Works offline.
create_mode_page_desc: One page or a list of them, with their images and styles.
create_mode_site_desc: A bounded crawl of one site, staying on its own domain.
create_mode_video_desc: Videos from a playlist or channel, with a page for each.
create_mode_import_desc: Convert a WARC or WACZ web archive into a ZIM.
create_offline_note: Offline mode is on — this needs an internet connection.
create_offline_sidecar_note: Offline mode is on, and the import helper is not installed yet.
create_ph_title: Taken from the source when left blank
create_engine_fast_desc: One request per page. Right for documentation, wikis, blogs and forums.
create_engine_rendered_desc: Runs the page in a headless browser and keeps what it draws — lazy-loaded images, cross-origin files, pages built in JavaScript. Slower, and the saved page is a frozen snapshot: its scripts do not run offline.
create_engine_missing: Not installed on this server. To enable it:
create_note_spa_rendered: This page builds itself in JavaScript, so the rendered engine is what will capture it.
create_engine_alive_desc: Records everything the browser receives and replays it offline, so the saved site's JavaScript still runs — carousels turn, menus open, pages built by scripts build themselves. Slowest, needs the most disk, and the result opens in a replay viewer rather than as a Zimi article.
create_note_spa_alive: This page builds itself in JavaScript. The alive engine records the scripts and the data they fetch, so it will still build itself offline.
create_ignore_robots_note: robots.txt is the site asking not to be crawled. Overriding it is a decision to own.
create_needs_source: Fill in the field above first.
create_restarted: The server restarted during this job. Nothing was added.
create_uncancellable: This one runs to the end once it starts.
create_unavailable_offline: The Create page has not been cached yet — connect once to use it offline.
create_needs_admin: Creating ZIMs needs an admin sign-in on this server.
create_warn_empty_folder: Nothing to package here — this folder has no files Zimi can read.
create_warn_not_html: That address is not a web page.
create_warn_robots: This site asks crawlers to stay out. Override it under Advanced only if the site is yours.
create_warn_no_ytdlp: yt-dlp is not installed, so video capture cannot run.
create_warn_empty_playlist: That playlist has nothing in it.
create_warn_not_archive: That is not a web archive — expected .warc, .warc.gz or .wacz.
create_warn_sidecar_offline: The import helper is not installed, and installing it needs the internet.
create_warn_probe_failed: Could not look at that source. The server log has the reason.
create_browse_truncated: Only the first folders are shown.
create_mode_bookmarks_desc: The pages you saved, packaged as one ZIM. Works offline.
create_bookmarks_note: You choose which folders on the next screen.
create_pages_note: One address per line — up to 20 pages in one ZIM.
act_empty_hint: Downloads, updates, creations, exports and deletions all land here.
